facts.fact: The World Bank's aide-mémoire says 336 communes were using the digital civil registration system SIECM at the December 2025 mission, up from 75 six months earlier and 40% of the project's target, while its offline module was only in demonstration since November 2025 and not yet deployed; the document does not say in words that the communes work online.
